in_sanskrit.name: धर्मपाल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who protects or upholds dharma (duty, moral virtue)

in_hindi.name: धरमपाल
in_hindi.meaning: धर्म (dharma, duty, moral virtue) + पाल (पालना, to protect, to govern, to maintain)
in_hindi.long_meaning: वह जिसका धर्म रखना होता है (he who protects or upholds dharma, duty, moral virtue)

in_tamil.name: திருப்பதிரம்பால்
in_tamil.meaning: திரு (respect, reverence) + பதிரம் (duty, moral virtue) + பால் (protector, guardian)
in_tamil.long_meaning: அவர் திருப்பதிரம் (he who holds reverence for duty and moral virtue) + பால் (protector, guardian)

in_telugu.name: ధర్మపాళ
in_telugu.meaning: ధర్మ (dharma, duty, moral virtue) + పాళ (పేజు, protector, guardian)
in_telugu.long_meaning: దేశే ధర్మపాళ (he who protects or upholds dharma, duty, moral virtue)

in_marathi.name: Dharampal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharampal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dharampal derives from the Sanskrit words dharma and pal. Dharma refers to righteousness, morality, or law. Pal means protector or supporter. Thus, Dharampal is a name that signifies one who upholds righteousness and protects or supports others.
